title: Agent runtime: Claude Code in an embedded pty in the project folder, skills shipped safely, first message, tab metadata, waiting dot
summary: Grillo can now start the member's own Claude Code in an embedded pty in the project folder, ship its grillo-* skills safely (kept out of git, tracked copies never overwritten), type the first message once the input box appears, and track each agent's tab name and waiting dot.
lessons_learned: Claude Code's folder-trust question defaults to 'No, exit': anything typing into a fresh Claude Code session must wait for the input box, not for any output
